title: Register a Special Mobility Vehicle
summary: This page provides information on how to register a Special Mobility Vehicle (SMV) or Nippi that travels faster than 10km/h as a 3-wheeled motorcycle.
intro:
A special mobility vehicle (SMV) is a 3-wheeled vehicle that a person can operate from their wheelchair, such as a Nippi.

If you have an SMV or a Nippi that can travel faster than 10km/h, you must register it as a 3-wheeled motorcycle.
who_can_apply: Must have an SMV or Nippi that travels faster than 10km/h.
what_you_need: Proof of your entitlement to register the vehicle (such as a receipt or a notice of disposal)
Authorised Unregistered Vehicle Inspection Scheme (AUVIS) certificate (blue slip)

how_to_steps.text: Submit your documents at a Service NSW Centre.

more_info.text: You do not need to register any type of motorised wheelchair or specially constructed conveyance if they do not travel faster than 10km/h.
Renewal notices are sent out by mail a few weeks before your registration expires. When you get the renewal notice you can renew your registration online or in person at a service centre.

faqs.q: What is a Special Mobility Vehicle (SMV)?
faqs.a: An SMV is a 3-wheeled vehicle that a person can operate from their wheelchair, such as a Nippi.

faqs.q: When must I register my SMV?
faqs.a: If you have an SMV or a Nippi that can travel faster than 10km/h, you must register it as a 3-wheeled motorcycle.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my documents?
faqs.a: You must submit your documents at a Service NSW Centre.
